description: A day-and-month with no year ('w/c 1 Dec') resolves against the note's date, so a note dated 2026-11-22 lands in 2026, not an earlier year.
failure_pattern: relative date resolved to the wrong year (seen in production: haiku_v1 atoms created 2026-11-22 with remembered_on 2024-12-01)

steps.text: Clio, the Heron migration review is w/c 1 Dec. Tom wants the rollback runbook finished before then.
steps.speaker: Tom
